I have written the delta requirements document to `.sdlc/runs/20261106-103142-feature-extend-lasso-selection-mode/requirements.md` based on the intent brief and repository sources (`packages/excalidraw/lasso/utils.ts`, `packages/excalidraw/lasso/index.ts`, `packages/excalidraw/tests/lasso.test.tsx`, `packages/excalidraw/tests/selection.test.tsx`, and `packages/excalidraw/CHANGELOG.md`).

### Summary of Contents
- **In scope & Out of scope**: Numbered, testable scope items covering mode-aware lasso selection (`"contain"` vs. `"overlap"`), bound-text and group containment semantics matching `elementsOverlappingBBox`, `LassoTrail` state wiring, test suite additions, Gate 0 option (a) pinning for `describe("lasso reselection")`, changelog entry, and strict write-allowlist boundaries.
- **Functional Requirements (`FR-1` to `FR-10`)**: Specified per module (`lasso/utils.ts`, `lasso/index.ts`, `tests/lasso.test.tsx`, `tests/selection.test.tsx`, `CHANGELOG.md`).
- **Non-Functional Requirements (`NFR-1` to `NFR-4`)**: AABB pre-filter retention, frozen write allowlist compliance, zero-warning lint/typecheck enforcement, and backward compatibility for direct `getLassoSelectedElementIds` callers.
- **PII Inventory & Role Matrix**: Documented as `None` and `Not applicable` respectively.
- **Acceptance Criteria (`AC-1` to `AC-10`)**: Numbered, executable criteria mapped directly to the intent brief and verification command (`yarn test:typecheck && yarn test:code && yarn test:app --watch=false`).
- **Open Questions for HITL**: `None` (all Gate 0 decisions are settled).
